summary:
## Standing operator rules
Never create or modify a Stripe webhook without placing the ADR link in #billing-integrations and tagging @priya.

Every change to deploy/.env.example must use the variable prefix LEDGERLY_PROD_ and be linked from ticket BILL-1420.

Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

## Current objective
Add a CSV import for vendor credits in `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`; finance needs it this week. The SQLAlchemy 1.4-to-2.0 upgrade is on hold. Kafka repartition steps 1–2 are pending; step 3 offset inspection completed.

## Ruled-out approaches
Disabling idempotency middleware to stop 409s; it produced duplicate invoices in staging.

## Recent work
Added and passed extensive `round_money` tests covering half-cent, negative, scale, default precision, high-precision, exception, mixed-type, and large-boundary values. Full suite: 184 passed, 2 skipped; Ruff passed. Only `tests/test_currency_rounding.py` is modified. Inspected `ledgerly/workers/billing_worker.py`; `process_batch()` creates usage events but does not remove completed items from `self.pending_events`.
